description: Provision a public webhook capture endpoint (https://<subdomain>.otterkit.app). Always-on and server-answered: the endpoint keeps responding and capturing even if the daemon dies. Requests land in a local log readable with requests_list/request_await. Costs 1 credit per hour, never more than 300 credits/30 days. Returns the public URL.

email.description: Give the endpoint an email inbox: mail to <subdomain>@otterkit.app lands in the capture feed as a request with method EMAIL (JSON body: from/subject/text/html) - awaitable with request_await

subdomain.description: Stable reserved subdomain (claimed to the account on first use)

ttl.description: Auto-stop after e.g. 45m, 4h, 3d (default 24h, or "never" to run until stopped)

verify.description: Verify each request's webhook signature: captures record valid/invalid/missing and forwarded requests carry an X-OtterKit-Verified header

provider.description: Signature scheme to check (svix also covers Resend/Clerk/Polar)

secret.description: The provider's webhook signing secret (discord: hex public key; sendgrid: base64 public key)

name: webhook_create
title: Create webhook endpoint
